title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The summary provided contains no article text beyond the headline, so the specific facts of this incident, including the lawyer's name, the court involved, the AI tool used, the number of fabricated citations, and the precise terms of the suspension, are not established from the available source material.

What the headline alone indicates is a category of failure that has appeared in other documented cases: a generative AI system producing plausible but fictitious legal citations, and a legal professional submitting those citations in a court filing without independently verifying their existence. This failure occurs at the point of human review, after the AI has produced output and before that output enters a formal record.

Whether the suspension resulted from a court finding, a disciplinary board ruling, or some other proceeding is not established by what has been provided.
